sample.question:
A load is energized only when every switch on its path from GEN is closed. After each toggle, sum energized demand. If it exceeds generator capacity, the protection relay trips and all loads become de-energized for the rest of that sequence.
Starting from the image, execute in order: toggle K1, toggle K3, toggle K4. What energized demand remains at the end?
A. 0
B. 1
C. 2
D. 3
E. 4
F. 5
sample.analysis: The step trace is [{'step': 1, 'toggle': 'K1', 'settings': {'K1': True, 'K2': True, 'K3': True, 'K4': True}, 'pre_trip_demand': 11, 'loads': [], 'relay_tripped': True}, {'step': 2, 'toggle': 'K3', 'settings': {'K1': True, 'K2': True, 'K3': False, 'K4': True}, 'pre_trip_demand': 5, 'loads': [], 'relay_tripped': True}, {'step': 3, 'toggle': 'K4', 'settings': {'K1': True, 'K2': True, 'K3': False, 'K4': False}, 'pre_trip_demand': 5, 'loads': [], 'relay_tripped': True}]. The relay trips, so final energized demand is 0. The answer is A.
